name: code-input
title: Code Input
description: Disables autocorrect, autocapitalise and spellcheck, catches smart quotes, en/em dashes, ellipses and hidden characters by line and column with a one-tap fix, and can validate JSON.

meta.stops: Smart quotes break a pasted command
meta.summary: A code field that turns off autocorrect and catches smart quotes, long dashes and hidden characters, so pasted commands and JSON don't fail invisibly.
catches: Curly quotes that break shell commands and JSON
En/em dashes where -- or - was meant (—force → --force)
Invalid JSON, with the parse error (json prop)
limits: Fixes are character substitutions; it doesn't check that the command or config is right
Intentional typographic characters inside strings may be flagged
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid and aria-describedby to an aria-live="polite" hint
Each issue lists its line and column in text
